p='candidate.lean'
s=open(p).read().split('\\n/--')[0]

s=s[:a]+\"        exact ⟨x.val, x.property, rfl, hx_in_ΔH.2⟩\"+s[b:]

s=s[:a]+\"\"\"    have h1 : ℓ + 𝓡 - (↑i + steps) + steps = ℓ + 𝓡 - i := by omega
    have h2 : ℓ - (↑i + steps) + steps = ℓ - i := by omega
    rw [h1, h2]
\"\"\"+s[b:]
s=s.replace(':= by gcongr\\n',':= Nat.mul_le_mul_left 2 h_bridge_nat\\n',1)
s=s.replace(':= by gcongr;',':= Nat.mul_le_mul_right _ h_fw_bound')

s=s.replace('by exact id (Eq.symm h_eq)','h_eq.symm')

python check_candidate.py candidate.lean"
